_doc: Status-light rules per desk. A desk takes the worst light among its rules. Every rule is shown to the user on click. Values compare against Ethiopia's latest primary observation.

ECON.text: CPI inflation: amber above 10%, red above 20%
GDP growth: amber below 4%, red below 0%

TRADE.text: Bab el-Mandeb transit vs window median: amber below −25%, red below −40%
Trade data: amber until a UN Comtrade key is configured

COMMS.text: Headlines feed: amber when the GDELT fetch is failing

DEBT.text: External debt to GNI: amber above 40%, red above 60%

HUMANITARIAN.text: People in IPC Phase 3+ (crisis or worse): amber above 3M, red above 10M

INFRA.text: Curated records not verified: amber if any, red above 3
Oldest curated verification: amber after 45 days, red after 90 days

WEATHER.text: Any city 7-day max temperature: amber above 38°C, red above 42°C
Any city single-day forecast rain: amber above 50 mm, red above 100 mm

SYSTEM.text: Sources OFFLINE: amber if one, red if more than one
